summary: SK hynix Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the routine disposal of 82 treasury common shares on August 19, 2026, to independent directors at a price of 1,500,000 Korean Won per share, totaling 123,000,000 Won. The disposal occurred during the period August 8 to September 7, 2026. After the disposal, the company holds 1,625,769 treasury shares, representing 0.2% of total shares. This is a minor administrative transaction with no strategic significance, not a capital return program or special situation.
